title: Source-derived contract factors: received declaration across serialization boundaries
basis: Existing provenance/provenance_cycle results are known; factorial extension and structural prediction, NOT blinded external demand.
extraction: Parse exact original and each patched Response class / HTTPAdapter.build_response with Python AST. Fail closed if __getstate__ is not dict comprehension over self.__attrs__ using getattr(self, attr, None), __setstate__ not setattr loop over state.items, or insertion markers not unique. Determine capture by assignment to response._received_declaration, serialization by membership in Response.__attrs__, accessor by AST pattern (absent/live/raw/normalized). No fit to runtime outcomes.

grammar.cost: one declared edit site per capture, whitelist and non-absent accessor (helper and property co-located). Separate sites, not measured labor; external sidecar previously known, not excluded as architecture-wide rival.

observers: mutation of headers to a different declaration
legacy encoding/text against untouched source, per stage
predictions: For adapter origin, received-value persistence requires capture AND whitelist AND normalized or raw accessor; direct/legacy unknown after serialization additionally requires normalization if whitelist present. All observers therefore require capture AND whitelist AND normalized accessor in this bounded internal grammar.
AST factor prediction must equal native observation for every case, otherwise record counterexample; no silent repairs.

Equal-information exhaustive CSP over all 16 candidate assignments and factor conditions must tie on admitted worlds/cost; compare naive capture-only / serialization-only shortcuts but no novelty claim from defeating weak rivals.
limits: No external networking or untrusted pickle.
Previously authored requirements and edits; no F38, causal labor, upstream patch or general source analyzer.
Freeze before writing factorial runner or observing its outputs. Tests must preserve baseline legacy text/encoding; if baseline cannot run, HOLD.
